title: The New Heavens and New Earth
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
searchTerms: The New Heavens and New Earth
definition: The New Heavens and New Earth are the final renewed creation where righteousness dwells and God’s redeemed people live with Him forever. God will not abandon His creation to corruption, but will make all things new.
summary: The New Heavens and New Earth are the final renewed creation where righteousness dwells and God’s redeemed people live with Him forever. God will not abandon His creation to corruption, but will make all things new.
christFocus: Jesus Christ secures the renewal of all things through His death, resurrection, and reign. The risen Lord will bring His people into a renewed creation where sin, death, and curse are gone.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The final hope of Scripture is not vague escape from creation, but the renewal of creation. God will make new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.

The present creation groans under the effects of sin, decay, and death. Yet its groaning is not hopeless. God’s redemptive purpose includes liberation from corruption.

Revelation shows the holy city coming down and God dwelling with His people. Death, mourning, crying, and pain will pass away because the former things will be gone.

This doctrine enlarges Christian hope. The Gospel does not end with forgiven souls floating away, but with resurrected people dwelling with God in renewed creation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers imagine eternity in ways that are less concrete and glorious than Scripture teaches. The New Heavens and New Earth show that God’s future is full, embodied, holy, and joyful.

This doctrine comforts those who suffer under creation’s brokenness. Disease, disability, disasters, pain, and decay are real now, but they will not rule forever.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set your hope on God’s promised renewal. Care about the world without worshiping it, endure suffering without despairing over it, and live now as one who belongs to the coming world where righteousness dwells.
